name: Jiangsu TongLin Electric Co.,Ltd.
summary: Jiangsu TongLin Electric Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, manufacture, and sale of photovoltaic (PV) module junction boxes, connectors, and related accessories in China and internationally. The company offers PV connection system products, including wiring harnesses, PV soldering ribbons, and inverters; PV power stations; electrical equipment, such as cable trays, bus ducts, and switch cabinets; cables and wires; and industrial automation solutions, as well as solar, automotive interior components, energy storage, biological technology, and drone products. It also engages in solar power station investment, operation, and power generation service…
